sentence: This project studies attacks on the sensors in augmented reality devices and builds defense algorithms against them.
This project designs control for active battery cell balancing in electric vehicles, so that less electricity remains unused.
This project studies how fluid flow and pulses of light open the membrane of T cells so genetic material can enter without viruses.
This project protects scientific software libraries from memory bugs and crashes by isolating them, so researchers need not modify their code.
This project develops statistical methods for single-cell and spatially-resolved sequencing data that work reliably without needing user input.
This project studies how people understand the thoughts and feelings of others, and how their brains make this possible.
This project builds instruments and data tools for measuring and imaging artifacts, biological remains and other heritage objects.
This project makes a nanolattice material with a low refractive index and high stiffness for microchips in augmented and virtual reality devices.
This project develops ways to test microservice systems for access control vulnerabilities and to harden them.
This project studies how House Finches produce red feather coloration and why it serves as an honest signal of individual condition.
This project builds a platform that combines multiple sensing approaches to detect and track unmanned aerial vehicles in low-altitude airspace.
This project studies computational graphs and kernel methods for scientific computing.
This project tests whether metabolic rate and yield trade-offs in microbes that use molecular hydrogen change with temperature and free energy.
This project tries to find out how plant cells determine the plane of cell division by studying motor proteins and microtubules.
This project tries to find out which microorganisms stay alive in an ice sheet and which genes help them survive burial.
This project studies how turbulent air near the ground helps tornadoes form in supercell thunderstorms.
